description: Search available functions for an overall goal and optional capability queries; returns compact function-id candidates grouped by worker.

capabilities.description: Up to six non-empty capability searches derived from the goal and current execution state. For one search at each decision point, include all unmet external capabilities once. When an unmet external capability is more precise than the overall `query`, include it in `capabilities`, even if it is the only one. Exclude intrinsic reasoning, summarization, planning, or formatting, and do not repeat needs already represented or satisfied. Requests to summarize provided text or content are ignored. Write every entry in English, translating non-English user requests while preserving proper names, URLs, and function IDs. When `capabilities` is absent, the overall `query` provides fallback ranking.

query.description: The overall task goal as one natural-language query. Always write it in English, translating non-English user requests while preserving proper names, URLs, and function IDs.

description.description: First description sentence, capped at 160 bytes.

InstallCall.description: A ready-made `worker::add` invocation: `{ function, payload }` matches the agent_trigger call envelope so the model can execute it verbatim.

InstallableWorker.description: A registry worker that is NOT installed but carries functions matching the query. `name` is the registry slug `worker::add` installs.

functions.description: Compact candidates only. After installation, search again and fetch selected contracts through `engine::functions::info`.

install.description: The exact call that installs this worker, ready to execute.

installable.description: Matching registry workers from verified authors. Their functions are NOT callable until the worker is installed.
